Sample CSCA questions with answers

One CSCA.ai-written question from each subject, in the same single-choice format as the exam. Try it before you open the answer.

Looking for CSCA past papers? The official Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry PDFs linked in our guide are sample questions, not complete papers from previous sittings. Our guide to official CSCA sample PDFs links to each PDF and explains how they differ from our own practice questions.

CSCA Mathematics sample question

A set contains exactly four distinct elements. How many proper subsets does it have?

A.888

B.151515

C.161616

D.242424

Show answer
Answer: B

A set with nnn elements has 2n2^n2n subsets, so a four-element set has 24=162^4 = 1624=16. A proper subset cannot equal the whole set, so subtract one: 16−1=1516 - 1 = 1516−1=15.

CSCA Physics sample question

A cart starts at 444 m/s and accelerates uniformly at 2 m/s22\ \text{m/s}^22 m/s2 for 333 s. How far does it travel?

A.121212 m

B.181818 m

C.212121 m

D.303030 m

Show answer
Answer: C

Use s=ut+12at2=4×3+12×2×32=12+9=21s = ut + \tfrac{1}{2}at^2 = 4 \times 3 + \tfrac{1}{2} \times 2 \times 3^2 = 12 + 9 = 21s=ut+21​at2=4×3+21​×2×32=12+9=21 m. Option A leaves out the acceleration term.

CSCA Chemistry sample question

Calcium ions have charge 2+2+2+ and chloride ions have charge 1−1-1−. What is the formula of calcium chloride?

A.CaCl\mathrm{CaCl}CaCl

B.CaCl2\mathrm{CaCl_2}CaCl2​

C.Ca2Cl\mathrm{Ca_2Cl}Ca2​Cl

D.Ca2Cl2\mathrm{Ca_2Cl_2}Ca2​Cl2​

Show answer
Answer: B

One Ca2+\mathrm{Ca^{2+}}Ca2+ needs two Cl−\mathrm{Cl^-}Cl− ions to balance its charge: +2+2(−1)=0+2 + 2(-1) = 0+2+2(−1)=0, giving CaCl2\mathrm{CaCl_2}CaCl2​.

CSCA practice test questions

Are the CSCA practice tests free?

Yes. Each free practice test has five questions in Mathematics, Physics or Chemistry, with the answer and an explanation for every question. You can start without creating an account.

Are these real CSCA exam questions?

They are exam-style questions written to the official CSCA syllabus, in the same single-choice format as the real papers. CSCA.ai is an independent preparation platform, not the exam organiser.

Are these CSCA past papers?

No. CSCA.ai does not host verified full papers from previous exam sittings. The exam organiser's Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry PDFs are official sample questions, not complete past papers. The free tests and worksheet here are original CSCA.ai practice material.

How many questions are on the real CSCA exam?

The Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry papers each have 48 single-choice questions in 60 minutes, and Professional Chinese has 80 questions in 90 minutes. Every paper is scored from 0 to 100.

What should I do after a free practice test?

Study the topics behind the questions you missed, then move on to full-length timed mock tests so you can practise 48 questions in 60 minutes before the real exam.
